why: A bank-lawyer interview at formality 7–8 calls for the most formal, polished piece: the taupe satin jacket-and-skirt suit in classic register, with matt brown suede shoes and leather bag keeping the sheen to one surface. I accept the satin sheen, the tonal all-neutral scheme and the suit's price on purpose, since they serve formality and a cohesive, authoritative look; o2 has a structural blocker and o5's cooler, loud silver and very costly shoes are weaker for her.
